entities.summary: Árpád Lengyel, né Árpád Weisz was a Hungarian physician, and ship's medical officer of the RMS Carpathia at the time of the sinking of the RMS Titanic. He played a key role in the salvage operation, welcoming the survivors on board the Carpathia.

entities.summary: Árpád Lengyel, né Árpád Weisz was a Hungarian physician, and ship's medical officer of the RMS Carpathia at the time of the sinking of the RMS Titanic. He played a key role in the salvage operation, welcoming the survivors on board the Carpathia.
